name: Kansa (bell metal / bronze) quarter / nasta plate, 8 in, single, hand-beaten (Odisha-made)
supplier_cost_note: UNKNOWN per piece. No per-piece supplier price for an 8-inch kansa quarter plate was found on 2026-11-27: a WebSearch for IndiaMART/Flipkart 8-inch bronze quarter plates returned no Indian listing. The only Odisha supplier price is the Deepak Metals, Puri IndiaMART storefront 'Kansa thali / katora Rs 1,400/Kg' (https://m.indiamart.com/deepak-metals-puri, carried over from the 2026-11-20 katori research, page not opened). Retail-stated weights for an 8-in kansa plate are 380 g (Velanstore; Zishta thali chart 8 in = 380 g) to 500-600 g (Green Heirloom), so the metal at Rs 1,400/kg comes to roughly Rs 532-840 per plate before making charge, packing and GST. That is an indication only, NOT a quote. Scratch evaluation with scripts/recommend.py evaluate() on 2026-11-27 at Rs 1,999 (Odisha supplier, all channels): cost Rs 532 gives Shopify 54.1% (expected Rs 888) and passes all four channels; Rs 700 gives 44.3% (Rs 727), all four; Rs 840 gives 36.1% (Rs 593), Shopify and Meesho only. Ask Deepak Metals (Puri) or a Balakati/Kantilo workshop for a written per-piece price for a 380-450 g 8-in plate, alloy ratio, MOQ and single-piece drop-ship.

risks: Supplier cost unknown: only a Rs 1,400/kg listing (Puri, Odisha) exists; per-piece cost depends on plate weight (380-600 g in retail listings) and making charge. Get a written quote before evaluation
Marketplace price UNVALIDATED: no Flipkart/Amazon.in/Meesho 8-in kansa plate price found. If generic 'bronze' plates sell well below Rs 1,999 there, use the website channel only
'Pure kansa / bell metal / bronze' and any alloy ratio are material claims needing a supplier test report (require_evidence_for_claims); brass or plated look-alikes are common
Food-contact item: no health or Ayurvedic benefit claims in copy (regulated-claim risk); sell as tableware only
Bell metal can crack if dropped hard and dents in transit; needs rigid padded packing. Hand-beaten pieces vary by about 100 g, so state weight as a range
Tarnishes; include a care card (no dishwasher) to limit 'not as pictured' returns
Overlaps with the kansa katori lead (RA-20261120-1): the same supplier quote can cover both, and a plate + katori combo is a possible later bundle (check the 2 kg slab)
